definition_zh: 平衡；天平；余额；使平衡；权衡
definition_en: an even distribution enabling steadiness; the remainder of an account; to keep or make steady
core_image: 两端的秤盘停在同一高度：不多不少，刚刚好
scene: 走钢丝的人展开双臂，脚下钢索纹丝不动。She stretched her arms to keep her balance.
sceneCN: 这里 balance 指「身体平衡」（第 1 个义项：稳定不倒的状态）；句意：她张开双臂保持平衡。

senses.title: Steadiness of body or thing
senses.definition: an even distribution of weight that keeps something upright
senses.definitionCN: 重量分布均匀使物体保持稳定
senses.example: Gymnasts need a perfect sense of balance.
senses.exampleCN: 体操运动员需要极佳的平衡感。
senses.why: Latin bilanx meant two-scaled: equal pans give stillness.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 bilanx 意为「双盘的」：两盘相等即静止。

senses.title: Even proportion of parts
senses.example: The dish balances sweet and sour.
senses.why: Equal pans extended to equal parts of anything.
senses.whyCN: 「两盘相等」引申为任何事物的各部分相称。

senses.title: Weighing instrument
senses.definition: an instrument for weighing with two pans
senses.definitionCN: 两端挂盘、用来称量的器具
senses.example: The chemist weighed the powder on a balance.
senses.why: The instrument is the word's oldest body.
senses.whyCN: 器具正是这个词最古老的载体。

senses.title: Remainder of an account
senses.definition: the amount left after adding and subtracting on an account
senses.definitionCN: 账户收付相抵后的剩余数目
senses.example: My balance at the bank is almost zero.
senses.exampleCN: 我的银行余额几乎为零。
senses.why: What remains when the scales settle is the balance.
senses.whyCN: 两讫之后天平上剩下的，就是余额。

senses.title: To make or hold steady
senses.definition: to keep something steady by distributing weight evenly
senses.definitionCN: 通过均匀分配重量使某物稳定
senses.example: She balanced the tray on one hand.
senses.why: The verb puts the pans back into level.
senses.whyCN: 动词把「两盘放平」的动作还原出来。

senses.title: To weigh two things against each other
senses.definition: to consider two things together in order to decide
senses.definitionCN: 把两件事放在一起考量以作决定
senses.example: You must balance risk against reward.
senses.exampleCN: 你必须权衡风险与收益。
senses.why: Mentally placing one thing on each pan is still weighing.
senses.whyCN: 在心中两盘各放一事，仍是称量。

senses.title: To pay the difference
senses.definition: to make two sides of an account equal, or to pay what remains
senses.definitionCN: 使账目两讫，或付清所余之数
senses.example: He balanced his checkbook at month's end.
senses.exampleCN: 他月末把支票簿账目轧平。
senses.why: Settling the scales once meant money as well.

senses.title: Idiom: on balance
senses.definition: after weighing everything, all things considered
senses.definitionCN: 全面衡量之后，总体来看
senses.example: On balance, the trip was worth the cost.
senses.exampleCN: 总的说来，这趟旅行值这个价。
senses.why: The idiom freezes the final reading of the scales.
senses.whyCN: 习语定格了天平的最终读数。

intro.en: Balance comes from Latin bilanx, having two scales, from bis, twice, and lanx, dish or pan; the two equal pans gave every later sense.
intro.cn: balance 出自拉丁语 bilanx「有两个秤盘的」，由 bis「两次」加 lanx「盘」构成；两盘相等之义生出此后一切义项。

items.en: The root behind lanx named a flat dish or plate.
items.cn: lanx 背后的词根指浅盘、平盘。

items.en: bilanx described the two-pan scales merchants used.
items.cn: bilanx 形容商人所用的双盘天平。

items.en: Late Latin shortened the compound to balancia.
items.cn: 后期拉丁语将复合词缩短为 balancia。

items.en: Old French passed balance on with the weighing sense intact.
items.cn: 古法语以称量义原样传递 balance。

items.en: English first recorded the instrument, then the verb and the account sense.
items.cn: 英语先记器具义，再出动词与账目义。

note.en: Group one holds the two-pan family and look-alikes; group two holds the steadiness field.
note.cn: 第一组收「双盘」词族与形近词；第二组收「稳定」义场。

entries.definition: a row of balusters; through an Italian folk link to the pan-word.
entries.definitionCN: 栏杆列；经意大利民间联系与「盘」词相关。

entries.definition: a woolen head covering from a place name in Crimea.
entries.definitionCN: 蒙面帽；出自克里米亚地名，词源无关。

entries.definition: weight that steadies a ship; from Scandinavian, though its job resembles balance.
entries.definitionCN: 压舱物；出自斯堪的纳维亚语，与 balance 词源无关。

entries.definition: a state of balance between opposing forces.
entries.definitionCN: 对抗力量间的平衡状态。

entries.definition: the quality of not being likely to fall or change.
entries.definitionCN: 不易倾倒或变动的性质。

normalIntro.en: balance is bi plus lanx: two pans hanging level.
normalIntro.cn: balance 即 bi 加 lanx：两只秤盘挂得一样平。

normal.cn: 词根：拉丁语 bilanx「双盘的」。

normal.en: Instrument: the balance in the chemistry lab.
normal.cn: 器具：化学实验室的天平。

normal.en: Idiom: on balance, after weighing all.

abstract.en: Feel the moment a seesaw stops moving.
abstract.cn: 体会跷跷板停住的一刻。

abstract.en: Balance is fairness you can stand on.
abstract.cn: balance 是可以站上去的公平。

abstract.en: Picture two cups of tea poured exactly even.
abstract.cn: 想象两杯茶倒得一般满。

examples.en: The budget must balance income and spending.
Her account shows a healthy balance this month.
On balance, the new rule does more good than harm.
examples.cn: 总的说来，新规定利大于弊。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「摆冷死」——天平两盘摆得一样平，冷冷静静分毫不差

root: 出自拉丁语 bilanx「双盘的」（bis「两次」+ lanx「盘」），经后期拉丁语 balancia、古法语 balance 进入英语；「两盘相等」是全部义项的源头。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses pivot on two equal pans: bodily steadiness, proportion, the instrument, the remainder, and the verbs of steadying, weighing, settling, and the final idiom.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项绕「两盘相等」转动：身体稳定、配比、器具、余额，以及使稳、权衡、结清诸动词与收束习语。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two pans hanging level.
core.cn: 核心意象：两只秤盘挂得一般平。

branches.en: The instrument carries the original pans.
Stillness and proportion grow from equal weight.
branches.cn: 静止与配比都由等重生出。

branches.en: The verb steadies things and weighs choices.
branches.cn: 动词使物平稳，也权衡抉择。

branches.en: Accounts settle when the scales level.
On balance is the last reading of the scales.
branches.cn: on balance 是天平的最终读数。

intro.en: The balance family keeps its Latin two-pan core and adds English prefixes for the broken states.
intro.cn: balance 词族保留拉丁「双盘」核心，用英语前缀表示失衡状态。

latinIntro.en: Latin kin come straight from lanx and bis.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁同族词直接出自 lanx 与 bis。

items.meaning: row of pillars supporting a rail
